references.text: Akira, son of Enan, is mentioned again as the leader of the tribe of Naphtali when the camp arrangement is described.
Akira, son of Enan, brings his offering as the chief of the tribe of Naphtali at the dedication of the altar.
Akira, son of Enan, leads the army of the tribe of Naphtali when the Israelites break camp from Sinai.
Naphtali was a son of Jacob and Bilhah, and the ancestor of the tribe of Naphtali that Akira represents.
The sons of Naphtali are mentioned among those who went to Egypt with Jacob, showing the origin of the tribe.
